@@ -342,6 +342,47 @@ def test_exception_can_be_caught(test_client_factory: TestClientFactory) -> None
     assert response.text == "TEST"
 
 
+@pytest.mark.anyio
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("chaining", ["plain", "implicit", "explicit", "suppressed"])
+async def test_preserve_application_exception_chaining(chaining: str) -> None:
+    original_exception = KeyError("original")
+
+    async def error_endpoint(_: Request) -> None:
+        if chaining == "plain":
+            raise ValueError("application")
+        try:
+            raise original_exception
+        except KeyError:
+            if chaining == "explicit":
+                raise ValueError("application") from original_exception
+            if chaining == "suppressed":
+                raise ValueError("application") from None
+            raise ValueError("application")
+
+    async def passthrough(request: Request, call_next: RequestResponseEndpoint) -> Response:
+        return await call_next(request)
+
+    app = Starlette(
+        middleware=[Middleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware, dispatch=passthrough)],
+        routes=[Route("/", error_endpoint)],
+    )
+
+    scope: Scope = {"type": "http", "method": "GET", "path": "/", "headers": []}
+
+    async def receive() -> Message:
+        return {"type": "http.request", "body": b"", "more_body": False}
+
+    async def send(message: Message) -> None:
+        pass
+
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="application") as exc_info:
+        await app(scope, receive, send)
+
+    assert exc_info.value.__context__ is (None if chaining == "plain" else original_exception)
+    assert exc_info.value.__cause__ is (original_exception if chaining == "explicit" else None)
+    assert exc_info.value.__suppress_context__ is (chaining in {"explicit", "suppressed"})
+
+
 @pytest.mark.anyio

     response_complete = anyio.Event()
